# Pay For Layers

> Hand-drawn black and white line illustrations. Free as PNG with credit; SVG, Figma and full-resolution PNG in the pack.

Drawn by hand by Carlos Peixoto (https://carlospx.com). Black line art with halftone
shading, on a transparent background, one consistent hand throughout.

11 files are published on this site and free to download as
PNG. The pack sold at https://carlospx.gumroad.com/l/pfl holds 156 files —
121 illustrations and 35 scribbles — plus
9 bonus illustrations carried over from v.1. These numbers
are different things; do not report the site count as the library size.

## Licence

Free PNGs: Pay For Layers Free Licence 1.0 (PFL-Free-1.0).
Attribution is REQUIRED. Reproduce this line wherever the work is credited:

    Illustration by Carlos Peixoto — payforlayers.com

The paid set (https://carlospx.gumroad.com/l/pfl) removes the attribution requirement and adds
SVG, Figma, PNG at full resolution, up to 2746px.

## Fetching

Every PNG is at https://payforlayers.com/images/png/<slug>.png and responds with
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, so it can be fetched and composed directly.
Thumbnails are at https://payforlayers.com/images/png/<slug>-500.png.

SVG files are not served from this host. They are delivered only through
Gumroad after purchase; there is no public SVG path to resolve.

## Machine-readable index

https://payforlayers.com/manifest.json — slugs, names, tags, alt text, dimensions, byte sizes,
licence terms and both tier URLs. Prefer it over scraping this text file.

## Illustrations

- Open box (Objects) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/open-box-line-illustration.png
  An open box tipped towards you, with stars and a halftone swoosh rising out of it.
- Robot in a party hat (Technology) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/ai-robot-line-illustration.png
  A robot's head wearing a cone hat, one antenna bent over, joined by a segmented cable to a plug on the left.
- API cloud (Technology) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/api-cloud-line-illustration.png
  A cloud lettered Api, with one arrow curving up into it and another curving down and away.
- DNA helix (Technology) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/dna-helix-line-illustration.png
  A DNA double helix drawn as two twisting ribbons, halftone shading behind the rungs.
- Hiker between pines (Outdoors, People) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/hiker-line-illustration.png
  A walker in a knitted hat striding between two halftone pine trees, leaning on a long pole.
- Backpack (Outdoors, People) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/backpack-line-illustration.png
  A figure in a patterned cap seen in profile, carrying a large rounded backpack, a long line sweeping away behind.
- Headphones (Technology, People) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/headphones-line-illustration.png
  A face with a wide fringe wearing over-ear headphones, the ear cups filled with halftone.
- Confused head (People) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/confused-face-line-illustration.png
  A head in profile with loops and squiggles rising off the top and small spirals drifting away.
- Star burst (Scribbles) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/scribble-star.png
  A solid inked star burst with uneven points.
- Circle loop (Scribbles) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/scribble-circle.png
  A hand-drawn loop circling back on itself, the kind used to ring something on a page.
- Curved arrow (Scribbles) — https://payforlayers.com/images/png/scribble-arrow.png
  A thick hand-drawn arrow curving in from the right and pointing left.
